dedupe_keys.name: nemsqar r package for national ems quality alliance measure calculations

description: nemsqar is an R package that automates the calculation of emergency medical services quality measures defined by the National EMS Quality Alliance, such as timely care for stroke, trauma, respiratory distress, seizures and hypoglycaemia, pain management, safe transport of children and avoidance of lights and sirens. It is written and maintained by Nicolas Foss and Samuel Kordik at the Iowa Department of Health and Human Services, which holds the copyright. The functions take EMS patient care records structured like the NEMSIS national data standard and return numerators, denominators and rates, optionally with confidence intervals, by agency or population. The package is generic: any agency or researcher with NEMSIS-style data can apply it. Version 1.2.1 was published on CRAN on 16 June 2026, with source on GitHub, and it is free under the MIT licence. Caveats: the package calculates measures but does not supply data, the full technical specifications of the measures require a free user profile on the NEMSQA website, and results depend on data completeness in the records. Simulation uses: producing service performance indicators to validate and calibrate EMS response and emergency care models, comparing agencies, and monitoring the effect of deployment changes. Related records: the NEMSIS public-release research dataset (data-nemsis-research-dataset) is the natural input.
